chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi reported to me, saying: Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Hamdani narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Zakariyya, and Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Salim among others, both narrated to us from Abdullah ibn Salim, who said: Hisham ibn Mihran narrated to us, from his maternal uncle Muhammad ibn Zayd al-Attar - who was among the prominent companions of al-A'mash - who said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn al-Hasan narrated to us, who said: Mundhir ibn Jayfar narrated to us, who said: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Bani narrated to us, saying:

I was in the presence of Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) when Umar ibn Qays al-Masir, Abu Hanifa, and Umar ibn Dharr entered upon him with a group of their companions. They asked him about faith. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "A fornicator does not commit fornication while he is a believer, and a thief does not steal while he is a believer, and one does not drink wine while he is a believer."

They started looking at each other. Then Umar ibn Dharr said: 'What shall we call them?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'By what Allah has called them and by their deeds.' Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'As for the male thief and the female thief, cut off their hands' (5:38) and He said: 'The fornicatress and the fornicator - flog each of them a hundred lashes' (24:2). They started looking at each other again.

Muhammad ibn Yazid said: And Bishr ibn Umar ibn Dharr, who was with them, reported to me, saying: When we went out, Umar ibn Dharr said to Abu Hanifa: 'Why did you not say: Who narrated from the Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'What can I say to a man who says: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said.'

key_terms.الإيمان: Iman (faith) - the state of true belief incompatible with major sin
key_terms.الخمر: Wine/intoxicants - all forms of alcohol forbidden in Islam
key_terms.مؤمن: Mu'min (believer) - one who possesses complete faith

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq say to Abu Hanifa about faith and major sins?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Amali of al-Shaykh al-Mufid, prominent scholars including Abu Hanifa and Umar ibn Dharr visited Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) to question him about faith. The Imam responded by quoting a prophetic hadith stating that major sinners lose the state of iman during the act of sinning, then cited Quranic verses (5:38 and 24:2) showing that Allah identifies sinners by their deeds rather than their faith status. The anecdote concludes with Abu Hanifa acknowledging the Imam's unassailable authority, as he could not challenge someone who directly cited the Prophet's words.
